openings.claim: Unequal topic familiarity may impede conversation entry.
openings.discriminator: Fresh starts improve reciprocal speech, especially with differing familiarity.
openings.probe: Randomly offer consenting pairs usual or equivalent fresh prompts plus one-minute introductions; privately record familiarity, observe individual speaking minutes, collect usefulness and preparation time.
openings.uncertainty: Proficiency and prompt differences remain alternatives; preparation feasibility is unknown.

openings.claim: Current versus earlier task confusion may cause preparation errors.
openings.probe: Compare existing and dated paper formats privately at handoff; separate earlier answers from blanks, correct misunderstandings, give everyone dated information, and log coordination time.
openings.uncertainty: Immediate identification may not predict later recall.

openings.claim: Optional individual scaffolds and alternating roles may support differing conversational challenge on shared fresh prompts.
openings.discriminator: Useful minutes increase and speaking gaps shrink; balance without usefulness weakens explanation.
openings.probe: Counterbalance usual and supported rounds; use sentence starters/extensions and two six-minute turns before support choice; observe individual speech, collect usefulness/entry slips, log preparation.
openings.uncertainty: Continuous self-calibration is speculative; reliable challenge signals and feasible scaffolds remain dependencies.

openings.claim: Six dated detachable cards may recover preparation continuity after absence without learner tracking.
openings.discriminator: Earlier-task errors fall; persistent blanks indicate another barrier.
openings.probe: Counterbalance current-sheet/packet identification; separate stale answers and blanks, follow six sessions, and count creation, printing and replacement effort.
openings.uncertainty: Requires fixed topics, self-contained tasks, packet retention or available spares.

decision: Test hypotheses within the valued structure. Remain free; exclude nobody for absence, preparation or refusing public proficiency labels. Use one room, 75 Wednesday minutes, no additional paid facilitation; provide preparation without smartphone/account. Measure conversational practice: six-session targets are 80% reporting ten useful minutes, 85% identifying preparation, coordination below 90 minutes/week. Synthetic, unlinked slips, untimed speech and unknown usefulness definitions limit inference; no target attainment demonstrated.
